title: ALDI Australia products, prices & Special Buys

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to fetch: keyword search, a category listing, specials (Super Savers, Lower Prices, Special Buys, Limited Time Only), products by id or barcode, any ALDI links, the list of categories, the full catalogue (~3,200 products; set Max items high, filters apply), or the store directory with hours and services.

queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Used in 'search' mode. Each query is searched separately.

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Used in 'category' mode, e.g. https://www.aldi.com.au/products/dairy-eggs-fridge/milk/k/1111111160 (or dairy-eggs-fridge/milk, or the key 1111111160). Tip: run mode 'List categories' to get every category URL.

productIds.title: Product ids
productIds.description: Used in 'products' mode: the number at the end of a product URL, e.g. 000000000000398691 (leading zeros may be left out: 398691).

barcodes.title: Barcodes (EAN / GTIN)
barcodes.description: Used in 'barcodes' mode: up to 100 GTIN-8/12/13/14 codes with valid check digits. ALDI maps each known code to product IDs. Unknown codes are reported in warnings; leading zeros are preserved. Example: 8000500003787 (Ferrero Rocher 200g).

urls.title: ALDI links
urls.description: Used in 'urls' mode: paste any product, search, category or Special Buys link (or a bare product id). The sort order is kept; a Special Buys date in the link overrides Special Buys dates below.

specialsGroups.title: Specials groups
specialsGroups.description: Used in 'specials' mode. Empty = all. Values: super-savers, lower-prices, special-buys (on sale now and announced), upcoming-special-buys (announced, not on sale yet), limited-time-only.

specialBuysDates.title: Special Buys dates
specialBuysDates.description: Used in 'specials' mode and for Special Buys links. On-sale dates in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2026-10-17. Empty = all dates; upcoming-special-buys still excludes dates on or before today in Sydney. With dates or themes selected and no Specials groups, only Special Buys are returned. A dated URL overrides this list.

specialBuysThemes.title: Special Buys themes
specialBuysThemes.description: Used in 'specials' mode and for Special Buys links. Exact ALDI theme names, e.g. Gardening or Tools and DIY. Empty = all themes; multiple themes are combined without duplicate products. Themes filter Special Buys only, before Max items. Complete nightly theme memberships are used when fresh; missing or stale memberships fall back to live listings.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum products per query / category / link, per store (after filters). For specials, products and the full catalogue: per run and store (the catalogue has ~3,200 products). Store directory: number of stores.

storeIds.title: Store ids
storeIds.description: Prices and range of these ALDI stores, each store as its own rows (some fresh produce, meat and liquor prices differ by store and state). The id is a letter and 3 digits, e.g. G525 (Darlinghurst NSW); mode 'Store directory' lists them all. Empty = ALDI's national prices (the ones with price history). Store prices come from our nightly read of every store (fetched live when it's older than this week's Wednesday).

postcodes.title: Postcodes
postcodes.description: Australian postcodes (up to 100): every ALDI store in each postcode, each as its own rows. A postcode without an ALDI gives no rows; the run warnings name its nearest store and distance, so you can add it to Store ids.

allStores.title: All ALDI stores
allStores.description: Run the searches / categories / specials in every ALDI store (~614). Combine with a small Max items: it applies per store.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Result order. Relevance, price and name are applied by ALDI before paging; unit price collects every match first, then sorts (cheapest per kg / litre / item first).

specialsOnly.title: Specials only
specialsOnly.description: Keep only products that are a Super Saver, Lower Price, Special Buy or Limited Time Only.

minPrice.title: Min price (AUD)
minPrice.description: Keep only products priced at or above this amount.

maxPrice.title: Max price (AUD)
maxPrice.description: Keep only products priced at or below this amount.

excludeCategories.title: Exclude categories
excludeCategories.description: Categories to leave out, by name or URL slug, e.g. 'Liquor' or 'christmas'.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Keep only these brands (exact brand name, any case), e.g. 'Farmdale', 'Belmont Biscuit Co.'.

excludeAllergens.title: Exclude allergens
excludeAllergens.description: Skip products that contain or may contain any of these, e.g. Peanut, Milk, Gluten. Products without allergen data are skipped too. Needs product details.

changedSince.title: Price changed since
changedSince.description: Return only products whose price changed since this date/time (e.g. 2026-10-12), or 'last-run' for changes since your previous run with the same input. National prices only.

includeDisappeared.title: Include disappeared products
includeDisappeared.description: With 'Price changed since' = last-run: also list products your previous run returned that are gone now (delisted or no longer matching), as rows with type 'disappeared'.

priceHistoryDays.title: Price history (days)
priceHistoryDays.description: Add each product's price changes from the last N days (0 = off). Every result always includes previous price, 30-day low and 90-day average once we have that history.

onlyNew.title: Only new products
onlyNew.description: Only products that appeared at ALDI in the last 7 days.

onlyNewSpecials.title: Only new specials
onlyNewSpecials.description: Only products that became a Super Saver, Lower Price, Special Buy or Limited Time Only in the last 7 days.

fetchFullDetails.title: Fetch full details
fetchFullDetails.description: Adds description, ingredients, allergens, storage, origin, variants and packaging images from the product endpoint. Newly fetched details also attempt barcode decoding from photos, confirmed against ALDI's SKU mapping; these image reads take extra time. A small charge applies per successfully fetched detail, including image reads. Cached details are included at no extra cost.

includeStock.title: Special Buys stock by store
includeStock.description: With storeIds, postcodes or allStores: add Special Buys stock observations. Nightly cache is used within Max cache age and never beyond 24 hours; missing or older observations are read live. Max cache age 0 forces live checks. Adds stockStatus, stockInfoDisplay, stockObservedAt and stockSource (cache/live), independently of the price timestamp. Low/no stock does not prove zero units. Failed lookups retain the price row with a warning. Extra requests are included in the product price.

maxAgeHours.title: Max cache age (hours)
maxAgeHours.description: We refresh every product nightly (Sydney time). Data older than this, or read before this week's Wednesday (Special Buys day), is fetched live instead. 0 = always fetch live.

includeRaw.title: Include raw payload
includeRaw.description: Add the original ALDI payload to each record (every field, including ones we do not map).
